verdict.rationale: Orb runs several built-in recurring processes: managed daily data exports, billing cycles that recur on subscription-aligned dates, and automatic dunning retries at 1, 4 and 9 days. It also lets you schedule effective dates for subscription edits. These are fixed, billing-specific schedules, not user-defined recurring jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: a general-purpose scheduler for custom recurring jobs or workflows, configurable cadence or cron-style schedules, API/SDK control over scheduled workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
